history.summary: A 1,216 sqft freehold 3BR dual-key in D14 (Geylang/Aljunied, TOP 2025), 610m from EW9 Aljunied MRT, at $2.29M / $1,883 psf. Freshly completed freehold dual-key flexibility and city-fringe location are the draw, but $1,883 psf is a full new-completion price for D14, dual-key is an investor-niche format, and there is no URA resale data to validate appreciation.
history.rating_rationale: Just-TOP'd freehold in city-fringe D14 with dual-key dual-income flexibility and decent Aljunied MRT access has a clear rental thesis. But $1,883 psf reflects new-completion developer pricing (resale won't repeat the new-launch lift), the dual-key layout narrows the resale buyer pool to investors, and $2.29M is at the upper edge of the liquid band. No URA series to confirm a trend. Reasonable rental hold, unproven as a capital play.
red_flags: $1,883 psf is new-completion pricing — limited resale re-rating headroom
Dual-key format narrows resale demand to investors
No URA appreciation/transaction data (TOP 2025, no resale history)
Geylang-fringe location stigma can cap broad buyer appeal
catalysts: Freehold, brand-new (TOP 2025) — low maintenance, full lease
610m to Aljunied MRT, city-fringe to CBD
